data.one_liner: A Flutter package for rendering text with clickable hyperlinks.
data.what_it_does: HyperLink is a Flutter widget that automatically detects and renders clickable hyperlinks within text. It allows custom styling for both links and non-link text independently and handles launching URLs in the default browser when tapped.
use_when: You need to render text containing markdown-style or standard links that users can tap to open in a browser.
You want separate styling for standard text and clickable links within the same text block.
avoid_when: You need a full-featured rich text or markdown rendering engine beyond basic hyperlinks.
You require complex gesture handling inside text other than opening URLs.
strengths: Automatically detects and renders clickable hyperlinks in text.
Provides independent styling for hyperlinks and regular text.
Supports a wide range of standard text configuration parameters like max lines, alignment, and overflow.
weaknesses: Limited to basic hyperlink rendering and URL launching.
No documentation on topics or advanced parsing beyond basic tags.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import it.
data.minimal_example:
HyperLink(
  textStyle: TextStyle(color: Colors.black, fontSize: 15),
  linkStyle: TextStyle(color: Colors.red, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontSize: 20),
  text: 'Click here to visit [Google](https://www.google.com)',
  linkCallBack: (link) {},
)
